data.narrative:
Neuralink is a private-stage AI & Software company that has raised $1.3B+ to date. The comparable universe for valuation consists of 1 public peer (Palantir Technologies, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI. However, the peer-median method is not applicable here: the AI & Software sector contains 16 same-sector peers overall, but only 1 same-stage company exists, with 0 adjacent-stage and 0 similar-tier peers meeting narrow filtration criteria. A peer-median approach would require a minimum of 3 datapoints to be statistically meaningful; the insufficient narrow peer set precludes reliable triangulation via this method.

Given the inapplicability of peer-median valuation and the absence of disclosed financial metrics or transaction comparables in the provided data, traditional triangulation methods cannot be executed with rigor. Any valuation range would necessarily rest on either (1) expansion of the peer set to broader sector or stage definitions—introducing heterogeneity risk—or (2) alternative methods such as DCF or revenue multiples, for which operational and financial data are not supplied.

The analysis therefore cannot support a specific valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties include the lack of disclosed revenue, growth trajectory, and near-term clinical or commercial milestones that would anchor fundamental value.
